to  support  and  encourage  the  services  provided  by

to give aid by way of scholarships to any officer or
servants engaged in the furtherance of the objects of
the  Corporation;
to  promote  understanding,  co-operation  and
friendship with similar institutions within and outside
Sri Lanka;
to  organize  employees  of  small  and  medium  scale
industries and enterprises and working towards their
future  advancement;
to  design  and  implement  social  mobilization
programmes  for  the  development  of  children  and
women  and  implementing  education  and  training
programmes for this purpose;
to  provide  training  in  fields  of  engineering,
technology,  carpentry,  driving  and  computing  to
young  men  and  women  who  do  not  get  access  for
higher  education  and  directing  them  towards  such
vocations and starting training centres necessary for
it; and
to do all such other acts and things as are necessary
for, and incidental or conducive to the attainment of
the above objects.
